title: Astro component scenarios cannot resolve their source
description: recapture-stale reports source-unresolved for all 25 component scenarios: the .astro entity extractor emits only Props, so componentName never resolves to a source file and staleness detection is inert — editing a component will not mark its screenshot stale. Fix by pinning pageFilePath per scenario, or by teaching the extractor to emit Astro component names.
